She wears a hooded gray robe with a darker waist sash, an ankle-length robe skirt with a slightly darker hem, and goes barefoot with simple ankle wraps. Pale skin, dark hair just visible under the hood, a clearly readable young face in profile with a visible eye, brow, nose and mouth. Realistic child body proportions, about 5.5 head-heights tall, matching the reference turnaround exactly in design, coloring and proportions. A deep anticipatory crouch immediately before a jump: knees bent low and hips dropped down close to the ground, weight sinking onto both feet which stay flat and firmly planted, torso leaning forward and down, head tucked slightly forward. Arms swing back and down behind her, elbows bent, coiled like a spring gathering energy. Full body visible from the top of the hood to the soles of both bare feet, and both hands, entirely inside the canvas with generous empty margin on every side so nothing is cropped. She is airborne and may sit higher or lower in the frame than a grounded pose depending on how high she has risen, but keep her at the exact same body scale (head-to-foot size) as the reference image(s), never bigger or smaller. Transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no vignette, no border, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the character, no scarf or neck wrap of any kind -- bare gray robe collar at the neck; a separate layer will add the scarf later.
